The sports center has several sports facilities: courts (padel and tennis, covered or uncovered) and rooms. Facilities are booked in time slots of one hour, with an hourly price that depends on the facility.
Only members can book. A member is a person who pays an annual fee to the Board and who, in exchange, can book facilities at a reduced price. Members of large families have an additional discount on the price of the bookings.
